audience: finance teams that chase overdue invoices and reconcile payments with Kolleno

useCases.title: List overdue invoices and what they owe
useCases.text: List the companies, then list invoices by payment status. Open one invoice for its balance, due date and contact persons.

useCases.title: Review a customer's balance and chasing status
useCases.text: List the customers with their balance, warning level and chasing status. Open one customer and list its contact persons.

useCases.title: Check chasing emails and workflows
useCases.text: List the chasing emails sent to a customer, with the invoice and step. List the chasing workflows and whether each is active.

useCases.title: Reconcile bank payments with invoices
useCases.text: List payment matches between bank payments and invoices. Open one match. Read the payment transactions of a customer.

useCases.title: Pause chasing or change an invoice due date
useCases.text: Stop or restart chasing on an invoice. You can also change its due date or description. Fields you leave out stay the same.

useCases.title: Set custom fields on a customer
useCases.text: Read the customer first. Then set custom field values on it. Only the keys you send change.
